new.analysis:
The athlete missed all planned runs for week 2026‑W39, so volume for the upcoming week should be low to allow recovery and re‑integration.  Build training usually increases volume gradually while adding one quality session; with only one quality session this week we can keep total mileage around 30 km.  We schedule three easy runs of 5‑6 km, one 6 km tempo, one 8 km long easy, and two rest days.  This keeps 80 % of the week easy, maintains injury protection, and gives the athlete a single quality effort near threshold pace.  The plan uses walk‑run structure because the athlete is new and still walking in most sessions.

Flags are written as watch items: volume, rest, quality, heart‑rate, pain/tightness.  No safety callout is required.
